[[File:Black robe detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''Black robe''' is one of the basic pieces of chest armour for low level [[Magic]] users. Black robes are often dropped by the [[dark wizard]]s in the stone circle south of [[Varrock]]. It has identical stats to the [[blue wizard robe]], as well as its [[Black wizard robe (t)|trimmed]] and [[Black wizard robe (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions. It can be created by using [[black dye]] on a blue wizard robe; similarly, it can also be turned into a blue wizard robe by using [[blue dye]] on it.

The black robe is often worn with the black [[wizard hat]] and [[black skirt]] for aesthetics. The hat has a slightly darker tone than the robes, instead more closely matching the [[priest gown]]. This is not the case with the robe's trimmed versions.

One of only three [[Body slot table (F2P)|free-to-play bodies]] with a magic attack bonus, the Black robe, [[Blue wizard robe]], and their [[Ornamental armour|ornamental variants]] get +1 [[Magic]] attack and -3 [[Prayer]] bonus compared to the [[Zamorak monk top]].
